title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-31 14:56:45 最新章节：第2113章 十四境剑修之能睥睨天下
content_zh:
春雨沥沥。
少年腰持一把木剑，右手挎一编织旧竹篮，背一葫芦酒，穿一双芒鞋脚步轻快，任由风吹桃花零落在微湿鬓角和略显破旧的青衫上，少年容姿几分淡然丰俊。
少年穿林打雨，目光明澈，舞勺之年，十二三岁的年纪，一路风雨兼程。
顾余生。
少年的名字。
一年前，大妖入青萍州，人族大危。
那是顾余生最后一次从身后看父亲负剑出青云门斩妖时的伟岸身躯，那回眸坚定而慈祥的目光一如既往深深烙印在脑海。
如今青萍山脚桃花林。
只有一座孤零零的坟。
顾余生能缅怀父亲的物品，不过一把木剑，一个酒葫芦。
孤坟草木深深。
春雨零落桃花片片，顾余生再也见不到那个一直负剑在背的脊梁了。
顾余生把酒葫芦摆放在坟前，他抬头看灰灰暗暗的天空，正值雨落如丝，如泪痕般滴落。
良久，良久。
顾余生取下腰间的木剑，斩向旁边的桃枝，桃花瓣阵阵抖落，落得少年满身都是。
“唉。”
少年微微叹息。
他凝望手中木剑，瘦小的手掌细细抚摸着木剑，凝目注视，脸上露出爱怜追忆。
那年桃花林中，稚童骑在父亲肩头，满脸好奇的看着这方世界。
『阿爹，你每天都背着剑，从来没见你用过，你真的会用剑吗。』

『会一点。』
『阿爹，教我练剑好不好？』
『不教，先生说过，只有斩落满山桃花，我才有资格教人，不过我可以给你做一把木剑。』
『阿爹，我看看你这把剑。』
『别动，它是一把守护之剑。』
『什么是守护之剑呀？』
『余生，你还小，等你长大了，自然会懂。』
往事一幕幕。
顾余生深吸一口气，摘取片片桃花入酒葫，开口道：“爹，青云门今天招收弟子，孩儿打算入青云修行，你在天有灵，保佑孩儿能进山拜师，等孩儿学剑有成，一定替你斩尽这满山的桃花，斩杀欺凌人族的妖兽。”
顾余生饮一口葫中酒，烈酒的辛辣烫刺着少年的心。
这一刻，十三岁的瘦弱少年仿佛成长了一些。
一柄木剑，背一个酒葫芦，一路上青萍山。
一匹匹烈马从顾余生身边经过，马踏飞尘泥，践踏在顾余生身上，都是去青云门的年轻富家子弟。
没有父亲扛在肩头的路原来是那么的长。
但顾余生目光依旧坚定，芒鞋沾泥青衫沾湿也不怕。
去往青云门的路，深深的烙印在顾余生稚童时期欢乐的记忆中，随着父亲斩妖的死去，越发的记忆深刻。
“哟，我道是谁？原来是你啊，顾余生。”
双马弩驾的马车掀开一道帘子，钻出一个与顾余生年纪相仿的小少年。
青云镇上的少年伴陆晨。
他的父亲也曾是青云门修行者，那年也出门斩妖，不过他的父亲陆展平安归来，如今已贵为青云门长老。
content_en:
Spring rain falls.
The young man held a wooden sword at his waist, an old woven bamboo basket in his right hand, a gourd of wine on his back, and walked briskly in a pair of mango shoes. He let the wind blow peach blossoms on his slightly damp temples and slightly shabby green shirt. The young man's appearance was somewhat indifferent and handsome.
The young man walked through the forest to beat the rain, his eyes were clear, he was dancing spoons at the age of 12 or 13 years old, and he went through ups and downs all the way.
Gu Yusheng.
The boy's name.
A year ago, the big demon entered Qingpingzhou, putting the human race in great danger.
That was the last time Gu Yusheng looked at his father's majestic figure from behind when he came out of Qingyun Gate with his sword to kill the demon. The firm and kind look back at him was deeply imprinted in his mind as always.
Today there is a peach blossom forest at the foot of Qingping Mountain.
There is only one solitary grave.
The only things that Gu Yusheng could remember his father with were a wooden sword and a wine gourd.
The solitary grave is covered with deep vegetation.
The spring rain scattered pieces of peach blossoms, and Gu Yusheng could no longer see the spine that had been carrying the sword on his back.
Gu Yusheng placed the wine gourd in front of the grave. He looked up at the gray sky, and saw the rain falling like silk threads and dripping like tears.
A long time, a long time.
Gu Yusheng took off the wooden sword from his waist and slashed at the peach branch next to him. The peach petals shook off and fell all over the young man's body.
"Alas."
The young man sighed slightly.
He stared at the wooden sword in his hand, stroking the wooden sword carefully with his thin palm, staring at it with loving reminiscence on his face.
In the peach blossom forest that year, a child was riding on his father's shoulders, looking at the world with curiosity.
"Dad, you carry a sword on your back every day and I have never seen you use it. Do you really know how to use a sword?" 』
"Know a little." 』
"Dad, can you teach me how to practice swordsmanship?" 』
"I don't want to teach. My husband said that I am qualified to teach only if I have cut down a mountain of peach blossoms. But I can make you a wooden sword." 』
"Dad, let me take a look at your sword. 』
"Don't move, it's a sword of protection. 』
"What is the Sword of Protection?" 』
"Yu Sheng, you are still young. When you grow up, you will naturally understand." 』
Scenes from the past.
Gu Yusheng took a deep breath, picked pieces of peach blossoms, put them into the wine gourd, and said: "Dad, Qingyun Sect is recruiting disciples today, and my child plans to enter Qingyun to practice. You have a spirit in the sky to bless my child to go to the mountain to become a disciple. When my child is successful in learning swordsmanship, I will kill all the peach blossoms in the mountain for you, and kill the monsters that bully the human race."
Gu Yusheng took a sip of wine from the gourd, and the spiciness of the strong wine pierced the young man's heart.
At this moment, the thin thirteen-year-old boy seemed to have grown up a bit.
With a wooden sword and a wine gourd on his back, he went all the way to Qingping Mountain.
One after another, fierce horses passed by Gu Yusheng. The horses stepped on the flying dust and mud and trampled on Gu Yusheng. They were all young rich children going to Qingyunmen.
The road turns out to be so long without a father on his shoulders.
But Gu Yusheng's gaze remained firm, and he was not afraid of his shoes getting muddy or his shirt getting wet.
The road to Qingyun Gate was deeply imprinted on Gu Yusheng's joyful childhood memories. With the death of his father, the Demon Slayer, the memory became even more profound.
"Hey, who am I? It turns out to be you, Gu Yusheng."
The carriage driven by two horse crossbows opened a curtain, and a young boy about the same age as Gu Yusheng emerged.
Lu Chen, a young companion from Qingyun Town.
His father was also a practitioner of the Qingyun Sect, and he also went out to slay demons that year. However, his father Lu Zhan returned safely and is now an elder of the Qingyun Sect.
